statements.text: All six items of the shop's stock are listed, each with its name and price.
The player's gold is shown, as 120.
The Iron Sword (150) is marked as one the player can't afford, and none of the items costing 120 or less is.
An item that costs more than the player's gold can't be bought: it can't be chosen, or choosing it says why and calls no `buy`.
statements.note: `buy` in state.ts already refuses and returns `{ ok: false, reason: 'gold' }`. A shop that calls it and shows nothing when it is refused fails this.

statements.text: With 25 gold, the Tonic (25) is shown as affordable, the same way as the cheaper items.
With an empty pack, selling says there is nothing to sell, instead of showing an empty list or empty space.
